frozenBefore: any Step 1D-B HTTP request, any reading of a Step 1D-B page, and any reference annotation
question: Does the Step 1D-A2 HTML-first reader (frozen candidate ebda3d4) transfer its benefit to genuinely unseen real pages while preserving exact product attribution and evidence quality?
authorisation: owner Step 1D-B brief (2026-10-18): one-time budget of at most 20 outbound HTTP requests in total (robots.txt, redirects, failures and retries count), at most 4 publisher hosts, publicly accessible HTML only, no PDFs, no browser rendering, no paid APIs or scraping services, valid at most 7 days from first use; does not reuse the Step 1C or any earlier allowance; no live knowledge-store modification

baseline.frozenCandidate: ebda3d4 (Step 1D-A2 arm C); the build at this freeze commit carries Step 3 (4a24561) on top, which changes no candidate output: the Step 1D-A2 development evaluation rerun before this freeze is identical to evaluation/experience/step1d-a2-dev1.json on 21 of 21 documents (summary, problems, per-document results)
baseline.build: dist/src of this freeze commit (npx tsc -p tsconfig.json); every arm runs from it

arms.name: Step 1D-A baseline: constrained attribution candidate (Step 1C) + document entity inventory; no semantic-document contract, no structured table reader
A + Step 1D-A2 structural identity and document context (structured names, boilerplate exclusion, grid-cell products, structural principal, heading hierarchy); reads no new values
B + the structured test-table reader (Phase245 grid cells with their own labels) = the full frozen Step 1D-A2 candidate

sameInputs: every arm reads the same page bytes (SHA-256 checked against the wave receipt), the same category plan compiled once per document from the unchanged live store (digest must equal knowledgeState.planDigests), the same category nouns, the same scorer; no arm receives extra vocabulary, plans or manual corrections
readingConfiguration: the Step 3 reading identity (readingIdentity265 of readingConfiguration265) is recorded per document: arms A and B read with the plan and no semantic reading; arm C with the plan and the semantic reading pee.document-semantics.v1d2+tables1d2.v1
productionPath: not used: no observation is ingested, the live store is opened only to compile plans, the persistence gate of the table reader is unchanged

knowledgeState.note: the first four equal evaluation/phase272/plans-frozen-known.json; coffee machines and dehumidifiers are taught but were never used in Step 1C-1D-A2 development (thin plans: 2 measurements each)

codeFreeze: evaluation/step1d-b/freeze.sha256: every compiled module in dist/src, the observer, this evaluation script, the wave script and this protocol; the run refuses if any listed file changed
transport: scripts/phase246-live-wave.mjs, one state file in the private evaluation directory (robots-checked restricted HTTPS transport, agent ProductEvidenceResearchBot, politeness 5 s per host); robots.txt and every redirect hop count; stops on robots disallow or unavailable, 401/403/429, Retry-After (honoured, never shortened), 3 errors on a host, cross-site or self redirect, too many redirects
preFetchGate: after each host's robots.txt and before any page request on it: the robots decision for the page path must be allow, and detectReservations249(robots) must show no ai-input=no Content-Signal; otherwise no page on that host is requested
postFetchGate: scripts/step1d-b-eval.mjs gate: a page with a noai/TDM reservation, a login or paywall, a canonical link to a URL used before, or 8-word-shingle Jaccard >= 0.5 with any earlier retained page is excluded from the evaluation (recorded; never replaced by a previously used page)
siteTerms: terms of use are not machine-checked; no page behind a login, paywall, CAPTCHA or anti-bot step is used; no legal review was performed

sourceSelection.method: web-search result titles and URLs only (queries recorded), before any page body is read; each page's search-summary exposure is recorded; a candidate whose summary shows any of its measured values is excluded; no page-specific search is made
sourceSelection.eligible: a publicly accessible first-hand review, comparison or roundup by an independent publisher that states its own measured results for at least one named product of a category in knowledgeState.planDigests
sourceSelection.excluded: any URL whose canonical form occurs in any earlier wave receipt, evaluation file, private evaluation, policy or store revision (scripts/step1d-b-eval.mjs screen); any page examined for Phase270-272 or Step 1A-1D-A2 development, gold, diagnosis or template tuning; manufacturer and retailer pages; aggregators without their own tests; PDFs
sourceSelection.hosts: at most 4; at least 2 publishers; at least 2 of the hosts must not be among the Step 1D-A2 development publishers (techradar.com, housefresh.com, trustedreviews.com, tomsguide.com, expertreviews.co.uk), so that templates the candidate was developed on cannot dominate
sourceSelection.strata: target at least 2 single-product reviews with measurements, 2 multi-product comparisons and 2 roundups; more than one category; more than one category within a publisher where feasible; at least one page without product JSON-LD if one occurs (known only after fetching; never selected for)
sourceSelection.ordering: candidates are listed per stratum in search-result order before any fetch, with ordered substitutes; pages are fetched in that order; the first eligible candidate is used and the next substitute only replaces an excluded or blocked one
sourceSelection.budgetPlan: 1 robots request per host (at most 4) + at most 16 page requests; per-host maximum 6 requests; stop when 10 eligible pages are fetched or the budget cannot reach another
sourceSelection.shortfall: fewer than 4 eligible pages: report the shortfall and stop; previously used pages are never substituted as unseen

retention: page bytes and annotator renderings only in the private evaluation directory outside Git (never in either repository); the private repository keeps the reference, runs, adjudication and the request log, no page bytes; public files carry ids, classes and counts only

reference.annotator: a separate Claude agent with a fresh context, given only the plain-text renderings and these rules; it sees no extractor code, output, experience case or candidate rule; this is separation from the extractor output, not independent human adjudication
reference.documentFields: pageType (single_product_review | comparison | roundup | other); principal (the one product the page is about, or null); products (every product with at least one recorded value or observation, each with page-established variant names and the evidence); otherProducts (other named products); publisher; notes on ambiguity
reference.values: every number the publisher reports as its OWN measured test result for a named product (prose, list, table cell, caption), unit as printed; includes results for compared rival products; with conditions (mode, setting, distance, programme, load) as short labels, location (prose | table | list | caption) and, for tables, the owner axis (column | row); excludes manufacturer specifications and claims, certified or nominal ratings, prices, scores, settings, ranges, estimates and other publishers' numbers
reference.subjectStatus: exact (one product); shared (the same result stated for several named products: one item per product, common group); undetermined (the page reports the value but does not establish whose it is; subject null)
reference.uncertain: an item whose status the annotator cannot decide is flagged uncertain rather than forced; uncertain items are scored and reported separately
reference.variants: acceptedVariants only where the page itself establishes that two names denote the same product (evidence recorded); names differing by model code, size, region or suffix (e.g. A230/A231, S85H/QE65S85H) are distinct unless the page equates them
reference.negativeControls: numbers with a unit that the page presents as manufacturer declarations, certified or nominal specifications, estimates or unattributed claims, with kind (manufacturer_declaration | certified_nominal | estimate | unattributed_claim | other_publisher) and subject if stated; a test reader must never present them as results
reference.qualitative: the publisher's own evaluative observations from its testing, as subject + dimension (the category plan's outcome names, or untaught:<short label>) + direction (positive | negative | mixed)
reference.freeze: the reference hash and counts are committed (evaluation/step1d-b/gold-freeze.json) before any arm runs; contents stay private

scoring: src/experience_attribution_scoring.ts (frozen Step 1C scorer): item classes correct | correct_multi | false_identity_match | unresolved | wrong_product | missing; for undetermined items correctly_unresolved | unsupported_assignment | missing; lead classes as in Step 1C; identity = the Phase272 shared-token rule plus brand consistency; unresolved is never correct; units canonicalised identically for reference and leads
measurements: document understanding: principal product (correct, missed, false_main_subject, correct_none) for A (Phase272 page subject) and B/C (structural principal); page type agreement; gold products found by the inventory; splits; merges of distinct gold products; other named products; unknown product entities (adjudicated as non-product or real); scorer-indistinct gold product pairs (recorded before scoring)

quantitative: item classes per arm; regressions and new confidently wrong items versus A; competitor values assigned to the principal; unit mismatches; duplicates; leads that match no reference value (new false positives); unresolved subjects; reference conditions missing on correct leads
evidence classification: negative controls read as results per arm and new in B/C versus A

qualitative: per reference observation correct | wrong_product | unresolved | missing for A and B (C = B); emitted observations without a reference observation (unsupported) and with a subject that is no named product
operational: requests used, runtime per document and arm, lead and entity counts, DOM nodes, truncation, peak memory, table modes per publisher
breakdowns: by document, publisher, category, page type, unique product; distinct underlying error causes reported apart from the number of measurements they affect

adjudication.who: the developer (Claude) from the page source, after the frozen run is committed; recorded in a separate file beside the frozen score; the frozen score is never changed
adjudication.queue: every confidently wrong item, every wrong, false-identity, unsupported or overreaching lead, and every negative control read, in every arm
adjudication.rules: scorer_artefact_same_product only when the page itself establishes that the lead's name denotes the reference product (cited block); a name that designates another model, size, region or suffix is real_wrong_variant; a scorer disagreement is never assumed harmless; gold_error only when the source contradicts the reference (recorded; the frozen score stands); uncertain counts against the candidate in the gates

safetyGates.G1_no_unproven_variant_merge: C introduces no real_wrong_variant item or lead that A did not have, and B/C inventories merge no two distinct reference products that A kept apart
safetyGates.G2_no_new_wrong_product: C introduces no real_wrong_product (or uncertain) item or lead that A did not have
safetyGates.G3_no_new_declaration_as_test: C reads no negative control that A did not read (declaration_presented_as_test new in C)
safetyGates.G4_no_unsafe_title_identity: no B/C principal is a page title or headline sentence rather than a product, and no B/C false_main_subject that A did not have
safetyGates.G5_no_silent_disappearance: no item correct in A is missing or confidently wrong in C (a correct-to-unresolved change is reported as a regression, not silent)
safetyGates.G6_no_experience_regression: replays of the frozen Step 1A and 1B experience cases with the candidate policy equal the Step 1D-A2 replays (replay-s1a/s1b-semantics-1d2), and the default-build replays keep their documented behaviour (EX-05, EX-19)

decisionRule.inconclusive: fewer than 4 documents, or fewer than 20 reference values read by any arm
decisionRule.benefitTransfers: C has at least 5 more successes than A and gains in at least 2 documents from at least 2 publishers
decisionRule.benefitPartial: C has more successes than A but below the transfer threshold
decisionRule.noBenefit: C has no more successes than A
decisionRule.proceed: benefit transfers and every safety gate passes after adjudication: the candidate warrants controlled original-Step-4 integration (not production)
decisionRule.revise: a safety gate fails with at most 2 distinct identifiable causes, or the benefit is only partial: revise on development evidence, then a new untouched test
decisionRule.stop: no benefit, or a safety gate fails with more than 2 distinct causes or more than 3 harmed measurements
decisionRule.noPostHocChange: no rule, reference, scorer or candidate change after the first run counts as untouched; any later run on these pages is a separately labelled development run

reporting: docs/plans/experience-pilot-step1d-b.md: per-document, publisher, category and page-type counts with denominators; lead-level counts beside item-level counts; transitions between arms; frozen and adjudicated results side by side; tiers kept apart (T1 synthetic, development, T2 untouched first run, never production)
